title: Reconsider FAQ: <di>, <div> or <li> wrapping <dt> and <dd>
body:
Explicitly grouping `dt` and `dd` together has been proposed so often that it’s featured in the [Rationale](https://wiki.whatwg.org/wiki/Rationale#Why_isn.E2.80.99t_there_a_grouping-type_element_for_description_lists_to_represent_individual_name-value_groups_.28e.g..2C_a_.E2.80.9Cdli.E2.80.9D_element.29.3F_It_would_make_styling_as_well_as_adding_microdata_to_individual_groups_much_easier..5B32.5D) and has been in the [FAQ](https://wiki.whatwg.org/wiki/FAQ#HTML_should_group_.3Cdt.3Es_and_.3Cdd.3Es_together_in_.3Cdi.3Es.21) since [2008](https://wiki.whatwg.org/index.php?title=FAQ&diff=3357&oldid=3356), getting further explained in [2010](https://wiki.whatwg.org/index.php?title=FAQ&diff=4917&oldid=4876). > This is a styling problem and should be fixed in CSS. There's no reason to add a grouping element to HTML, as the semantics are already unambiguous. There will be no CSS pseudo-element `::wrap` in the forseeable future, see https://github.com/w3c/csswg-drafts/issues/588. I believe it’s therefore worth to reevaluate the use cases and review the FAQ entry. ## Current state The [parsing rules for `dl`](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/semantics.html#the-dl-element) are quite clear, but even if browsers implemented them perfectly, there’d still be no way to take advantage of the structure in CSS. ``` html
term
alias
definition
term
definition
alternate definition
term
alias
definition
alternate definition
``` ## `di` Wrapper This has also been called `dli`. It has all the problems of any new element type, and some more. ``` html
term
alias
definition
term
definition
alternate definition
term
alias
definition
alternate definition
``` ## `li` Wrapper It has all the problems of using existing elements in places where they were not supposed to occur previously, which can be quite unexpected. ``` html
  • term
    alias
    definition
  • term
    definition
    alternate definition
  • term
    alias
    definition
    alternate definition
    • ``` ## `dt`/`dd` in `li` It may be worth exploring whether ditching `dl` has better backwards compatibility than changing it. ``` html
    • term
      alias
      definition
    • term
      definition
      alternate definition
    • term
      alias
      definition
      alternate definition
    ``` ## Generic `list` element ``` html header
    term
    definition
    term

    definition

    alternate definition
    term

    alternate definition
  • item ```
